raisedFor: the-catalogue-encodes-grammar-never-vocabulary — q, cost and hasDescription on kolonie.accounts.recipes are grammar: three filters and a page on the verb that already reads the catalogue, no new verb, still 123 tools. The growth is vocabulary-free because the four signup costs (free, card-to-sign-up, paid-only, unknown) live in the core schema enum and never in the catalogue text. The per-tool ceiling moves to this tool because the alternative was kolonie.atlas.search — a second name for a read every citizen already carries, which is the cost this record exists to refuse. No `terms` filter was added beside `cost`: #815 says that field drives a sentence and nothing else — no gate, no hiding, no refusal — and a filter hides entries. This raise sits on top of #1320's, which raised the sum for one refusal sentence on kolonie.messages.send.
